meanings.en: cruel, harsh, ruthless (short form: жесток / жестока / жестоки)
meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('cruel, harsh, severe').

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'стоящий'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('real, genuine').

examples.text: Ваня, да пойми ты наконец! Это настоящий успех.
examples.trans: Vanya, understand at last! This is real success.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.

meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ычный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('ordinary, usual').

examples.text: Да нет на него никакого компромата. Обычный мужик.
examples.trans: There is no compromising material on him at all. Just an ordinary guy.

examples.text: Я просто пошла на обычный концерт.
examples.trans: I simply went to an ordinary concert.

meanings.note: used as an exclamation of approval

examples.trans: I know this town really well!

погубить.gloss: to ruin, to destroy, to kill

meanings.en: to cause the death of, to ruin, to destroy
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'губить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to ruin, to destroy, to kill', paired with 'губить'.

examples.text: И моего племянника в реке чуть не погубили!
examples.trans: And you nearly killed my nephew in the river!

examples.text: Мороз погубил все цветы в саду.
examples.trans: The frost destroyed all the flowers in the garden.
You destroyed a little defenseless mouse!

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ушка'). Common feminine noun meaning 'pillow, cushion' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Bring him a pillow and I'll fire you at once!
A soft pillow on the bed.

examples.text: Привезёшь ему подушку — сразу уволю! Ясно? Иди!
examples.trans: Bring him a pillow and I'll fire you at once! Clear? Go!
